tool_input.new_string:
assert parsed.options.image == "busybox" and parsed.options.name == "w"
  end

  test "spec parses `instance up` and routes to the Up command" do
    assert {:ok, [:instance, :up], parsed} =
             Optimus.parse(DockdCLI.CLI.spec(), [
               "instance",
               "up",
               "--package",
               "web",
               "--source",
               "github.com/me/pkgs"
             ])

    assert parsed.options.package == "web"
    assert parsed.options.source == "github.com/me/pkgs"
  end
